purpose: Prevent an invocation observed before the currently verified successor due from overwriting or consuming that still-pending fast occurrence.
rule: Before BOOT_STARTED/provisional rearm/substantive authority, compare observed invocation time with fresh durable verified_next_fast_due_at / successor_expected_at. If invocation is earlier than the pending verified due, classify PREMATURE_INVOCATION. Do not count it as delivery success, do not advance authority, and do not replace the pending due with an 11 minutes (660 seconds) provisional. Preserve or restore the SAME MAIN recurring DTSTART to the pending verified due when it is still future and live-safe. Only a generation whose observed invocation is at/after its expected due may proceed through the normal provisional-arm path.

timing_semantics.normal_provisional: eligible wake reference + exactly 11 minutes (660 seconds)
timing_semantics.premature_tolerance_human: 0 seconds; any invocation before the verified due is not evidence of that due being delivered

evidence_basis: Epoch 85 invocation was observed at 08:28:42 KST while the predecessor's live-verified fast due remained 08:29:51 KST, 1 minute 9 seconds (69 seconds) later. Blind provisional rearm would have canceled the still-pending P0-B test, so the pending due was restored before it elapsed.
rollback: Remove this fence only if controlled evidence proves early invocation is the provider's valid delivery semantics and preserving the pending due causes worse correctness; until then fail closed for substantive authority on premature wakes.
